children: French finance minister Roland Lescure said on Friday that the country's budget deficit will be over 5% of gross domestic product this year.
"The reality is that 5% is no longer an option today," Lescure told reporters.
French officials had warned that the country would enter the danger zone with international creditors if its budget deficit surpassed 5% in 2026.
